config.students_desc: Serndhu padichom, sirichom, tension aanom, theory-la irundhu viva varai ellaththaiyum somehow survive panniyum vittom. Ippo ovvorutharum different paths-la pogaporinga… aana namma serndha moments-ah marakka mudiyadhu… College days mudinjidalaam, namma memories mudiyadhu. We're going to miss you… always. ❤️
config.memories_desc: Every photo holds a little piece of the memories we made together. Namma moments, namma memories — captured forever. 🥹
config.flashbacks_desc:
Some moments were meant to be lived. Others were meant to be replayed. 🥹
Namma serndhu vaazhntha moments… kaalangal maarinalum, idhu mattum maaradhu.
Thirumbi paakumbodhellam, namma college days konjam neram thirumbi varum. ❤️
config.wishes_desc: Anyone can leave a wish. Say something nice, something funny, or something only a fellow Pharm student would get. Mostly the last one. 😄

anthem_rows.text: We came here for a degree, but along the way we got so much more — friends, silly moments, last-minute studying, practicals, assignments, exams, and memories we didn't know we'd miss this much. 😄📚💊
There were days we couldn't wait to leave college. And now that the day is actually here, none of us really wants to say goodbye. 🥺
We laughed together, struggled together, survived exams together, and made memories that no syllabus could ever teach us. 👪❤️✨
This isn't really goodbye. We're just taking different paths from here.
At last, time has come to say farewell. 👋 But don't forget that there's a junior who always remembers the special moments shared with you. 🥺❤️

config.anthem_quote: ✨ Four years of moments, now a lifetime of memories.
